{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to float, coercing errors to NaN
# This will handle any non-numeric strings (like '0.00' -> 0.0)
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Re-check the dtypes to confirm
print("After conversion, data types:")
print(df.dtypes)

# Check for any NaNs introduced by conversion
print("NaNs in 'revenue' after conversion:", df['revenue'].isnull().sum())"}
